_comment: ngsolve nonlinear_elasticity#0 (det(F) must stay > 0). Observed 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: the u=-2x guess gives Integrate(Det(F))=-1, a.Energy=nan, a.Apply fills the residual with NaN, and solvers.Newton aborts with 'UmfpackInverse: Numeric factorization failed'. No FloatingPointError is raised -- NGSolve returns NaN silently, so the claim's 'FloatingPointError or NaN' is NaN-only here. Load-stepping the same -0.4 compression from u=0 keeps Det(F)>0 over the whole domain and converges each step.
